text: …おぼえて　いきませんか？

structure.jp: …おぼえて　いきませんか？
structure.en: ...won't you learn it before you go?

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.span: おぼえて　いきません
patterns.explanation: いく after a て-form says you do the thing and then leave. おぼえて　いく = 'learn it and then go'.

patterns.name: 〜ませんか
patterns.explanation: ませんか is a polite way to invite someone, like 'won't you...?'. おぼえて　いきませんか = 'won't you learn it before you go?'.
